sermon.title: What Happens After You Die?
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this short message Pastor David G. Kincer says your spirit leaves the body at death and you immediately stand before Jesus Christ to give account for what you did in this body. He describes visions of hell and the judgment and urges people to turn.

And when Jesus had cried out with a loud voice, He said, “Father, ‘into Your hands I commit My spirit.’ ” Having said this, He breathed His last.

chunks.section_question: What did he see of hell and the judgment?
chunks.short_answer: Hell was not pleasant, isolation is part of it, and at the judgment no one said a word because they knew they were wrong.
chunks.text: My eyes were open to see hell and it wasn’t pleasant. And then my eyes were open to that judgment day and people were standing before Christ and no one was saying a word because they knew they knew they were wrong when they did the wrong there was no debates there and it was a horrible thing to be in hell and people that say well I’m going to go hell that’s where my sons and daughters are my best friends you are a fool. Hell is not a pleasant place and if you think you’re going to have friends down there forget it. Isolation is one of the parts of hell. Knowing the terror of the Lord we try to persuade men we try to get them to turn. And that’s why Christ died on the cross so you would not have to burn.

faqs.question: Could anyone kill Jesus?
faqs.answer: No; He was God and gave up His life Himself.

faqs.question: Do believers stand before the judgment seat?
Are we judged by our faith?
faqs.answer: He says by what was done in the body, good or bad.

faqs.question: What did God show him on the freeway?
faqs.answer: The sin in the homes he passed, and he would weep.

faqs.question: Will you have friends in hell?
Can I blame my spouse for drugs?
What happens in the light of the throne?
faqs.answer: Every impure thing is exposed and people know they were wrong.
